scope: Primary-source review for an event/question/sample-identifiable Senate polling data vintage public by 2018-10-23. No model fit, source admission, or owner-data modification.

decision.reason: The contemporaneous FiveThirtyEight file carries a FiveThirtyEight poll number and previous election outcomes, but lacks question/sample IDs, original source URLs, release dates, question text, population, and complete field interval. The richer later FiveThirtyEight polls archive postdates the target cutoff; other contemporary API/report alternatives were mutable, unavailable, or incomplete.

target.interpretation: Past-cycle outcomes can be labels in a 2018 as-of replay only where they were known by the target cutoff. This does not make later-reconstructed poll records, derived error fields, or current revisions contemporaneously available.

five_thirtyeight_2018_partial_archive.article_publication_time: 2018-05-30 11:00 AM (article page local time; timezone not inferred)
five_thirtyeight_2018_partial_archive.article_claim: Database download link; includes polls in final 21 days for gubernatorial and congressional elections since 1998; over 8,500 polls in total.
five_thirtyeight_2018_partial_archive.article_access_caveat: The current article URL redirects to ABC News politics. Search indexing retained the May 30, 2018 article title/date and substantive text; this review did not recover the original HTML page from a contemporaneous web archive.
five_thirtyeight_2018_partial_archive.timestamp_caveat: A valid signature authenticates the commit payload and its declared commit timestamp; it does not by itself prove the exact object was publicly retrievable on that date. The same-day publisher article says the database was downloadable; no contemporaneous server retrieval log was found.
five_thirtyeight_2018_partial_archive.license: CC BY 4.0 according to the prior source packet; preserve attribution and version link. Underlying third-party releases remain a separate rights consideration.

2018_readme_findings.date: polldate: median field date, not publication date
2018_readme_findings.sample_size: samplesize may be estimated from margin of error or similar polls; defaults to 600 if no better estimate exists
2018_readme_findings.candidate_labels: In D/R races candidate 1 is Democrat and candidate 2 Republican; candidate #1/#2 definitions may be top two finishers regardless of poll candidate list

five_thirtyeight_2018_partial_archive.coverage_limit: For congressional polls, this 2018 ratings database is a final-21-day accuracy sample, not an exhaustive time series or every historical poll release.

richer_later_archive_rejected_for_as_of_.current_data_page_history_note: Its indexed page says the separate polls dataset was last updated September 26, 2023; that is well after the requested target vintage.

endpoint_status.interpretation: No such file at current GitHub path

richer_later_archive_rejected_for_as_of_.conclusion: Richer row schema is useful as a post-target forensic source only; the repository path's first recorded public commit postdates the 2018 cutoff. Current database IDs, created_at values, URLs, or later field classifications cannot be back-projected as contemporaneous availability proof.

publisher_poll.question: 2012 Arizona Senate, Jeff Flake versus Richard Carmona; candidate order rotated

sample_identity_case.event_assessment: Publisher primary release -> 538 poll-event correspondence verified from release date/content, field date, sample, population, question and toplines.
sample_identity_case.tierney_assessment: Strong candidate association, unverified event/sample identity. Same labels, date string and normalized conditional share do not prove the same respondents, sample or instrument. The candidate values are author-derived, and their sum is not the publisher N. No source lineage is available to join the Tierney row to pollno 5385932 or the Rasmussen release.

huffpost_api_announcement.what_it_proves: Pollster's API maintainer announced question-oriented API v2 and raw-data responses; warned the database could be edited and change between requests.
huffpost_api_announcement.limitation: No preserved, dated 2018 complete response or source-vintage record was found. It was a live mutable API, not an authenticated archived snapshot.

aapor_2016_report.source_description: The report says public-domain poll-level datasets came from FiveThirtyEight, HuffPost Pollster, and RealClearPolitics; it supplements design variables manually from press releases, news stories, methodological reports, and pollster websites, contacting pollsters when details were missing or unclear.
aapor_2016_report.limitation: Public report is not a downloadable complete event/source crosswalk and does not provide stable original sample/question IDs for all Senate polls.

chen_and_tierney.limitation: Both postdate cutoff; prior schema audit found no stable poll/question/sample IDs or row-to-release source crosswalk.

lucid_2016_microdata.limitation: Pollster-authored 2016 microdata include survey column and exact questionnaire file, but release is post-cutoff, covers Lucid's own 13 surveys rather than a historical archive, and does not provide a pre-2018 dataset vintage or broad previous-election outcome cohort.

captures_and_rights.raw_polling_data: No raw poll data or release PDF copied into this packet. The existing 538 CC-BY source capture and Rasmussen HTML captures remain at their pinned prior paths.

access_failures: FiveThirtyEight's 2018 article URL now redirects to the ABC News politics landing page; original article availability is supported by its indexed publication metadata/text and the dated archive/commit, not by current direct page retrieval.
The detailed FiveThirtyEight current/historical Senate CSV URL returns an ABC News HTML shell, not CSV; GitHub raw path has no file.
The former HuffPost Pollster API URL returns 404 NoSuchKey; no historical as-of snapshot was recovered.
No primary Tierney-to-Rasmussen sample/question source lineage was located in the author source packages inspected earlier.
next_concrete_source: For a future row-level audit, obtain the original Chen/CNN poll table and source crosswalk from the Harvard Dataverse / Code Ocean replication capsule or request the dataset acquisition record from Yehu Chen / Harry Enten. For an authorized 2018-as-of cohort, use the pinned May 2018 FiveThirtyEight archive only after explicitly excluding the 2018 cycle from training, separating actual outcome labels from poll features, manually resolving source release/question/population for each candidate, and treating the 538 poll IDs as archive IDs rather than original sample IDs.
